title: Volume and Liquidity
description: Why it matters how many people are trading.

slides.title: Trading Volume
slides.content: Volume is the total number of shares traded in a day. Apple might have 50 million shares traded, while a tiny penny stock might only have 5,000.

slides.title: High Liquidity
slides.content: High volume means High Liquidity. It's easy to buy or sell instantly at fair prices because there's always someone willing to trade with you.

slides.title: The Danger of Low Liquidity
slides.content: If you own a stock with low liquidity, you might be stuck. When you want to sell, there might be NO buyers, forcing you to slash your price dramatically just to escape.
